The specification contains 8 user stories (U1 to U8) related to Spring XD / Spring Framework modules.

technical_and_design_decisions: Use Java 17+ as required by Spring Framework 6.0.
Implement graceful shutdown using Spring Lifecycle callbacks and message draining techniques to ensure messages complete their journey to the sink.
For the centralized GitHub module registry, utilize the GitHub API for module upload and synchronization across the cluster.
For the HDFS custom module registry, use the Hadoop FileSystem API to manage module bits and remove the custom-modules.zip artifact from YARN distribution.
For the Mail source, leverage Spring Integration's mail support with configurable JavaMail properties for SSL/TLS.
Refactor Flo parser endpoints to centralize and streamline error reporting strategy.
assumptions: Access to Rackspace infrastructure is available and configured for benchmarking RabbitMQ.
The developer has the necessary permissions and access to move code from the spring-xd-module repository to the core repository.
Existing test suites are available and can be extended for the new features.
The environment setup for shell auto-configuration will rely on standard init file parsing and execution.
Integration with external systems (GitHub, HDFS, IMAP/SMTP) will use standard, well-documented APIs.

activities.activity_description: Analyze all user stories (U1-U8), define the system architecture, and design the integration points for the new features.
Migrate the project reactor based gpfdist from the spring-xd-module repository to the core framework, ensuring compatibility and updating dependencies.
Implement a centralized module registry using a GitHub repository, allowing module uploads and cluster synchronization via the GitHub API.
Set up and execute benchmarks for RabbitMQ on Rackspace infrastructure to evaluate scaling as xd-container nodes are added.
Refactor and improve existing Flo parser endpoints to streamline the error reporting strategy.

activities.activity_name: U5 - Mail source secured IMAP/SMTP support
activities.activity_description: Enhance the Mail source to support secured IMAP and SMTP connections using java-mail properties for SSL/TLS configuration.

activities.activity_name: U6 - HDFS default for custom module registry
activities.activity_description: Set HDFS as the default distributed remote location for the custom module registry and remove the custom-modules.zip artifact from the YARN distribution.
Implement automatic configuration for the shell against a pre-defined environment setup using an init file.
Implement an option to gracefully shutdown streams, ensuring messages complete their journey to the sink before the stream is stopped during undeployment.
Perform integration testing across all new features, ensuring they work together seamlessly and meet the specified requirements.
Update documentation to reflect the new features and prepare deployment scripts and configurations.
